scope: Actual research-only preview files, not deployed or substituted into product
recipe: PNG master, Pillow12.2.0Lanczos nearest integer height, GaussianBlur0.65 at thumbnail resolution, cwebp1.6.0-m6-ICC pinned588B, q20/q70+sharp_yuv or lossless-exact-q100; source alphapreserved
limits: 1x1 is flat-color patch, not recognizable photo or valid geometric composition
Minimum is within this tested WebP recipe, not universal mathematical minimum
Smallest lossy candidate may visibly damage color/detail; selection is a size bound, not automatic final quality approval
Sizes include588BICC and container; dataURL base64 sizes are raw strings before HTML compression
No true full-resolution pixel fidelity claimed for intentional preview
Originals will still load later; previews ADD eventual bytes when originals viewed
No production runtime/delivery changes, no real-world load-time guarantee
